name: Faerie
description: The realm of power in Mythic Europe most associated with human belief, where stories are born, live, and die; generally weaker than the Divine and Infernal but closest in nature to Magic.

name: Divine
description: The realm of power that easily dominates Faerie and discourages pagan worship; its Dominion aura covers human settlements and penalizes faeries.

name: Infernal
description: The realm of power that seeks to undermine and corrupt Faerie; faeries subverted by demons are treated by the Divine as devils.

name: Magic
description: The realm with most in common with Faerie; faeries are not penalized by Magic auras, and Magic favors old subjects rooted in the natural order.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica, in whose realms of power Faerie is described.

name: Arcadia
description: The part of the Faerie Realm where new stories made to entertain arise, traversed by the Path of Chance; some say faeries retreat there when they cease their roles.

name: Elysium
description: The world of the Faerie Realm holding myths and tales of great deeds, where characters meet heroes, villains and faerie gods; reached by the Path of Destiny.

name: Eudokia
description: The world of the Faerie Realm where one's personal story, moral dilemma, or life transition is told; reached by the Path of Choice.

name: Path of Chance
description: The route through the Faerie Realm that wends through Arcadia, a land of pure adventure among fragments of stories yet to be told.

name: Path of Destiny
description: The straighter route through Elysium, where characters relive allegorical stories whose outcomes are already established.

name: Path of Choice
description: The route twisting through Eudokia, where characters' morals and emotions drive personal change.

name: The Three Worlds
description: The three paradigms of the Faerie Realm, Arcadia, Elysium and Eudokia, corresponding to stories that entertain, record history, or teach.

name: Mother Road
description: The source of all roads, identified with the Faerie Realm itself, used to traverse vast distances swiftly via trods.

name: Glamour
description: The intricate mystical rules (a corruption of 'grammar') a faerie must follow, defining its nature, powers, appearance and how it seeks vitality; faeries have glamour instead of a soul.

name: Vitality
description: Human energy borrowed by faeries that lets them feel, grow, learn and change; roused by emotion, art, offerings and life transitions.

name: Cognizance
description: The degree to which a faerie understands its need for human vitality and the relationship between its glamour and role.

name: Incognizant
description: The lowest level of faerie cognizance: faeries unaware they feed on human vitality and without memory across bodies; the most common sort.

name: Narrowly Cognizant
description: Faeries aware they feed on human vitality but understanding only a single narrow mechanism; their memories persist across bodies.

name: Highly Cognizant
description: Rare faeries aware of their needs who can seek creative humans, develop new powers and change roles.

name: Role
description: The series of symbols and rules a faerie cannot change or break through which it interacts with humans.

name: Spiritual Anchor
description: A mundane object into which a faerie writes its glamour, around which its body agglomerates; it holds the faerie's vis.

name: Incidental Matter
description: Dust, water and other matter a faerie draws around its spiritual anchor to form its body.

name: Stock Characters
description: The caricatured folk-tale personas faeries often adopt when pretending to be human.

name: Taboo
description: Rules within a faerie's glamour forbidding or requiring actions; humans breaking them owe redress. Detailed as Flaws.

name: Pretense
description: Minor magical powers by which faeries simulate human Abilities, costing no Might and needing no Concentration.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A mystical link; faerie possessions, speaking with, eating the food of, or bleeding for a faerie create Arcane Connections with Penetration multipliers.

name: Traditional Ward
description: Folk protections against faeries that can purge glamour links; violent faeries are fed by the wards used against them.

name: Sovereign Ward
description: A ward against faeries capable of purging their glamour from a human, detailed in Faerie Characters.

name: Free Expression
description: Virtue possessed by artists whose works lift the spirit and feed faeries; also lets humans change faeries through eloquence.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
description: Story Flaw that may be caused by a broken faerie taboo.

name: Enemy
description: Story Flaw that may result from breaking a faerie's taboo.

name: Faerie Aura
description: Supernatural aura arising where the fae are strong, usually equal to the presiding faerie's Might/5; the Faerie Realm itself has an aura of 10.

name: Aura
description: The supernatural presence of a realm in a place; Faerie auras rise and fall with faerie Might and conflict with other realms' auras.

name: Extend Glamour
description: Faerie Power whose possessor creates an aura of (Faerie Might/5) over places it claims with its glamour.

name: Faerie Might
description: The measure of a faerie's power, used for auras, Threshold interactions and powers.

name: Camelot
description: Legendary Arthurian site duplicated by faeries in several places, near Edinburgh, in Winchester and near Caerleon.

name: King Arthur
description: Legendary king whose role is played by several faeries at Arthurian sites; a Merinita magus met at least three Arthurs.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal of a Merinita magus who explained how faeries flock to legendary sites.

name: Edinburgh
description: City in Scotland near which one faerie Camelot was found.

name: Winchester
description: English city within which one faerie Camelot was found.

name: Caerleon
description: Welsh site near which one faerie Camelot was found.

name: Scotland
description: Only in a small part of Scotland is the term glamour used in Mythic Europe.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Covenant ritual whose tokens allow a faerie to use its powers without facing the covenant's magical resistance.

name: Terra Nullius
description: An area of another realm home to no conscious thing, which faeries sense and may enter freely.

name: Queen of Winter
description: Powerful incognizant faerie who kidnaps babies for sinister games and whose travelling glamour freezes villages.

name: Bluebeard
description: Faerie role of a handsome husband who turns hideous when his wife breaks a taboo and sees his victims' corpses.

name: Fata
description: Faeries who inconspicuously join weaving and gossip sessions among elderly village women, using Pretenses to weave.

name: Brownie
description: Household faerie given milk on the doorstep, fed by traditional offerings.

name: Vampire
description: Faerie fed by the tribute of garlic over windowsills, metaphysically like a brownie.

name: Werewolf
description: Example of an incognizant faerie, unaware it feeds on human fear rather than on sheep.

name: Faerie Dragon
description: Fey dragons that devour knights and feast on fear, or exist to be defeated.

name: Faerie Court
description: Gatherings of faeries usually located in semi-settled land between wilderness and Dominion, sometimes near vis sources.

name: Forest lord
description: Faerie ruling a forest whose aura falls when land is felled and tilled.

name: Steward
description: Lesser faerie left to tend a site while its principal travels, holding a little of its glamour.

name: External Vis
description: Faerie Virtue allowing a faerie to leave its spiritual anchor at its site while its body roams.

name: Regio
description: Layered supernatural areas very common in Faerie areas, caused by an affront to the presiding faerie's glamour.

name: Faerie Sight
description: Virtue allowing a character to read how to enter a faerie regio level.

name: Second Sight
description: Ability that lets a character perceive regio entrances and trods, but not help enter the Faerie Realm.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Virtue allowing perception of regio entrances and trods.

name: Piercing the Faerie Veil
description: Intellego Vim spell that reveals regio entrances.

name: Sense the Nature of Vis
description: Simple Intellego Vim spell that reveals whether vis is of faerie type.

name: Ball of Abysmal Flame
description: 35th-level spell; botched in Faerie it may become an Ignem anima faerie that follows the magus with criticism.

name: True Love
description: A character whose True Love is within a regio can always find its entrance.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability quantifying understanding of, bargaining with and predicting faeries; used to guess regio entry actions and pass Guardians.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used with Perception to notice faerie Pretenses and find regio entrances.

name: Threshold
description: The simultaneous attraction and repulsion between Faerie and the mundane world; entering Faerie requires Threshold points equal to Threshold strength.

name: Threshold faerie
description: Faeries that gain vitality by helping humans cross the Threshold, all having the Spirit Away power.

name: Trod
description: A geographic boundary with a Faerie aura, always a Significant Threshold, connecting regio levels and leading onto the Mother Road.

name: Faerie Road
description: Paths used by faeries with 'right of way', commonly corpse roads to churches; the most common type of trod.

name: Right of Way
description: The ancient right of faeries to travel through a locale without permission.

name: Encased Vis
description: The most common faerie vis: Magic vis over which a faerie has laid glamour to claim it.

name: Accrued Vis
description: Vis formed when faeries end their roles, from fragments of glamour left in matter or shed accouterments.

name: Sleeping Vis
description: A material object with simple glamour but no vitality that may awaken as a faerie if given vitality; prized by House Merinita.

name: Abstract Vis
description: A promise made solid: glamour on matter that seems enchanted but holds no real vis, honored by the faerie's servants.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power magi hunt; in faeries it resides in the spiritual anchor.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House focused on Faerie whose magi study the Faerie Realm, pay for sleeping vis, and possess Arcadian Mysteries.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House whose magi report that principal faeries prefer two lieutenants in a five-act regio structure.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi whose members speculate on the origins of faeries.

name: Arcadian Travel
description: Merinita Mystery Virtue letting a magus create a charm that grants Threshold points and brings companions into Faerie.

name: Faerie Magic
description: Ability whose score limits how many people an Arcadian Travel charm can take along.

name: Wayfarers
description: Group within House Merinita expert in using the Mother Road.

name: Spirit Away
description: Greater Faerie Power (Vim) letting a faerie add Threshold points to mortals at 1 Might per point, or send them out of Faerie.

name: Portage
description: Faerie Power of faerie wizardry allowing entrance into the Faerie Realm and exploitation of the Mother Road.

name: Guardian of the Threshold
description: The first entity met on entering Faerie, testing travelers' resolve by offering a choice to go on or back; may be passive, animal, human or monstrous.

name: Kerberoi
description: Merinita term for fearsome monster Guardians of the Threshold, always restrained and bypassable by trickery or courage.

name: Fable Points
description: Points gained by playing along with stories in the Faerie Realm, building a fable score that grants control over the story.

name: Common Sense
description: Virtue all faerie characters are assumed to have while in the Faerie Realm.

name: Warping
description: Effect that may be acquired when leaving the Faerie Realm, to which faeries are immune.

name: Animae Magic
description: Rules from Mystery Cults for creating faeries with magic, used for botches in the Faerie Realm.

name: Ignem Anima
description: Faerie created from a botched Ignem spell in the Faerie Realm.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Minor faerie Virtue giving 3 Threshold points.

name: Strong Faerie Blood
description: Major faerie Virtue giving 9 Threshold points.

name: Faerie Heritage
description: Faerie Flaw giving 3 Threshold points.

name: Craft
description: Ability used with Dexterity for Aesthetic Quality of artwork adding Threshold points.

name: Profession
description: Ability used with Communication for artistic Aesthetic Quality.

name: Aesthetic Quality
description: Measure of artwork quality added to Threshold points when the art commemorates Faerie.

name: Faerie Wizardry
description: Practices by which humans draw on Faerie power; penalized heavily in Divine and Infernal auras.

name: Hermetic Magi
description: Practitioners of Hermetic magic who study and hunt faerie vis.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique used with Vim to perceive regio entrances and faerie vis.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form of magic itself, used in spells like Piercing the Faerie Veil.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire.

name: Olympians
description: Ancient gods whose war against the Titans may have been a conflict between Faerie and Magic.

name: Titans
description: Mythic opponents of the Olympians.

name: Tuatha De Danann
description: Irish mythic beings who fought the Fomorii.

name: Fomorii
description: Mythic opponents of the Tuatha De Danann.

name: Æsir
description: Norse gods who with the Vanir fought the Jotnar.

name: Vanir
description: Norse gods allied with the Æsir against the Jotnar.

name: Jotnar
description: Norse giants opposing the Æsir and Vanir.

name: Zeus
description: Ancient god likely resembled by faeries.

name: Lugh
description: Ancient god likely resembled by faeries.

name: Odin
description: Ancient god likely resembled by faeries.

name: Cronos
description: Fabled opponent of Zeus with faerie versions in the Faerie Realm.

name: Balor
description: Fabled opponent of Lugh with faerie versions.

name: Ymir
description: Fabled opponent of Odin with faerie versions.

name: Cain
description: Faeries are said by some to be his descendants, gone to Arcadia when banished to Nod.

name: Land of Nod
description: Place of Cain's banishment, equated by some with Arcadia.

name: Dionysios
description: God whose vineyards exist only in stories about him in the Faerie Realm.

name: Avalon
description: Legendary land with no existence independent of the stories it appears in.

name: Olympos
description: Legendary land existing in Faerie only within stories.

name: Vanaheim
description: Legendary land existing in Faerie only within stories.

name: Stonehenge
description: Legendary site that can be visited in the Faerie Realm only within a story.

name: Salisbury Plain
description: Plain around Stonehenge.

name: Glastonbury Tor
description: Legendary site not reachable from a story unless part of it.

name: Summer Kingdom
description: Example Faerie destination reached through story choices, not geography.

name: Goat Hill
description: Hill with a Faerie Aura 5 used in a Threshold example with Branoic.

name: Branoic
description: Young man who stumbled into the Faerie Realm on his stag night climbing Goat Hill.

name: Saint John's Eve
description: Time when faerie hills and barrows open; characters climbing there usually return at dawn.

name: Swan Maidens
description: Faerie beings featuring in stories of the Faerie Realm.
